About_&_Key_Points:
About
Alok Industries is a textile company with a presence in the cotton and polyester segments. The Company is engaged in manufacturing of textile, including mending and packing activities; leather and other apparel products.
Key Points
Business Divisions
1) Polyester (61%):
The co. is fully integrated starting from the continuous polymerization plant to the production of chips, POY, FDY, DTY, and PSF.
2) Apparel Fabric (18%):
Includes woven fabric, knitted fabric, garments, and safety textiles.
3) Home Textiles (12%):
Sells bedding and terry towels.
4) Cotton Yarn (9%):
Produces cotton and cotton blended fabrics in various counts on a wide range of finishes.
